intro: A gleaming machine hums in the clearing, plastered with hand-written notes and… is that a shipping chart?
title: The Fanfic Fabricator
description: A sign reads: @[TOOLTIP_TITLE]{EVERY THEORY IS TRUE IF YOU BELIEVE HARD ENOUGH.} The machine seems to recognize one of your Pokémon. A slot at its front is exactly Pokémon-sized.
invalidSelection: The machine has no headcanon about this Pokémon.

1.label: Step Into the Machine
1.tooltip: (?) The machine rewrites one of your lore-touched Pokémon according to… fan theory
1.selected: The machine whirs violently. Somewhere, a message board erupts in vindication.

2.label: Back Away Slowly
2.selected: The machine's hum turns distinctly passive-aggressive as you leave.

lore.ditto: The failed clone remembers what it was meant to be!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became the Mew it always dreamed of — though old habits die hard.
lore.mew: The original learns what its copy endured!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became a Ditto — but its power remains undiminished. It cannot Transform. It refuses to.
lore.kabutops: Team Plasma's blueprints, a fresher fossil!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became a Genesect of the ancient seas!
lore.genesect: The armor comes off at last!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} remembered being a Kabutops — and kept the cannon.
lore.cubone: The skull comes off. The mother was waiting.$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} was reunited — her spirit fights beside it forever.
lore.kangaskhan: She picks up the small bone club and does not let go.$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} armors up in memory of what was lost.
lore.gengar: The shadow peels off the wall and takes shape!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became the Clefable it was always mimicking!
lore.clefable: Every moonlit thing casts a shadow…$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became its own shadow — and kept the moonlight.
lore.porygon: ERROR ERROR M~ N?!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} h4s bec0me… s0mething gl1tch3d. Its data will never sort correctly again.
lore.dragonair: The timeline where it kept its grace!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became what it should always have become.
lore.raichu: Restored from the cutting room floor!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became Gorochu — fangs, horns, and all!
lore.arcanine: The Pokédex said Legendary. The Pokédex does not lie.$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} finally lives up to its category.
lore.sudowoodo: Fake it until you make it!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} finally became a real tree. It is no longer afraid of rain.
lore.luvdisc: The evolution chart everyone drew in the margins!$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} became what the playground always promised.
lore.vaporeon: The Brass Tower burns. The rainbow wings descend.$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} was reborn as Suicune — the water it once was still flows within.
lore.jolteon: The Brass Tower burns. The rainbow wings descend.$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} was reborn as Raikou — no beast alive matches its old speed.
lore.flareon: The Brass Tower burns. The rainbow wings descend.$@s{level_up_fanfare}{{pokemonName}} was reborn as Entei — burning hotter than any legend.

outro: The machine powers down with what can only be described as smug satisfaction.
